entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We got our route, so what's left to talk[n]about? Let's just send the callin' card[n]and take that Treasure!
entries.uk: Шлях є, то про що ще балакати?[n]Шлемо візитну картку[n]й забираємо Скарб!

entries.en: Having said that, we'll join you if you[n]want to keep exploring. There might[n]be more info around!
